SELECT O.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, O.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, O.CHANNEL AS channel, P.PAY_CENTER_ORDER_NO AS payCenterOrderNo, P.CHANNEL_ORDER_NO AS payCenterChannelOrderNo, P.PAY_CHANNEL_CODE AS payChannelCode, P.PAY_TYPE AS payType, O.ENTRY_STATION_CODE AS inStationCode, O.EXIT_STATION_CODE AS outStationCode, S1.STATION_NAME AS inStationName, S2.STATION_NAME AS outStationName, O.TICKET_PRICE AS ticketPrice, O.TICKET_NUM AS ticketNum, O.ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, O.SINGLE_TICKET_TYPE AS singleTicketType, O.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, R.REFUND_NO AS refundNo, O.REFUND_STATUS AS refundStatus, O.REFUND_AMOUNT AS refundAmount, TO_CHAR(O.LAST_REFUND_TMS, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lastRefundTime, TO_CHAR(O.CREATE_TMS, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createTime, TO_CHAR(O.UPDATE_TMS, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM ( SELECT ORDER_NO, ORDER_STATUS, CHANNEL, ENTRY_STATION_CODE, EXIT_STATION_CODE, TICKET_PRICE, TICKET_NUM, ORDER_AMOUNT, SINGLE_TICKET_TYPE, DEVICE_ID, REFUND_STATUS, REFUND_AMOUNT, LAST_REFUND_TMS, CREATE_TMS, UPDATE_TMS FROM F2F_ORDER
ORDER BY CREATE_TMS DESC, ORDER_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY ) O LEFT JOIN F2F_PAYMENT P ON P.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND P.ATTEMPT_NO = (SELECT MAX(P2.ATTEMPT_NO) FROM F2F_PAYMENT P2 WHERE P2.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO) LEFT JOIN F2F_REFUND R ON R.ORIG_ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND R.ID = (SELECT MAX(R2.ID) FROM F2F_REFUND R2 WHERE R2.ORIG_ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO) LEFT JOIN STATION_INFO S1 ON S1.STATION_CODE = O.ENTRY_STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN STATION_INFO S2 ON S2.STATION_CODE = O.EXIT_STATION_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE F2F_ORDER O SET REFUND_AMOUNT = ( SELECT NVL(SUM(R.REFUND_AMOUNT), 0) FROM F2F_REFUND R WHERE R.ORIG_ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' ), REFUND_STATUS = CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(R.REFUND_AMOUNT), 0) FROM F2F_REFUND R WHERE R.ORIG_ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS') <= 0 THEN 'NONE' WHEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(R.REFUND_AMOUNT), 0) FROM F2F_REFUND R WHERE R.ORIG_ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS') >= O.ORDER_AMOUNT THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, LAST_REFUND_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATE_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
